verdict.summary: The round-two change remains correct and non-vacuous. The scanner identifies the two load-bearing prose restatements with an exact file-set assertion, then compares every discovered token set to the workflow-derived trigger set; the existing #607 assertion independently pins that workflow value. Focused controls demonstrate detection of one-line and wrapped copies, inequality on drift, and exclusion of quoted Python lists and partial references. Thus neither an empty scan nor coordinated prose drift can pass silently. The diff changes no executable production behavior, permissions, routing, trust check, or audit binding, and contains no reviewer-directed prompt injection.
